purpose: Compose trained immutable PPO snapshots with supervised Haskell inference through a bounded exact-bit request decoder.
data: Synthetic ALPHA/BETA analytic 180-row price prefixes with zero funding; no historical data or holdout.
budget: Nine synthetic engineering fits, 27 observation cases, generated decoder round trips and bounded failure/mutation tests. Repeated canonical verification is not an independent financial trial.
scope: No serialized policy artifact, dataset loader, OPE, production Python service, deployment, risk-setting change or order interface.
acceptance: Reproduce existing v2 process fixtures and new source-bound model/SMT/compiled conformance. No new broad closure inferred.
